issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in next_id() can cause duplicate IDs in concurrent writes

summary.root_cause: Race condition in next_id() - IDs computed from in-memory data without synchronization between load and save operations
summary.fix_approach: File-based locking using fcntl.flock with atomic_update() method wrapping load-modify-save sequence

validation.regression_test: passed (demonstrated failure before fix, passes after)

risks.platform_limitation: Uses fcntl which is Unix-specific; may not work on Windows
risks.lock_file_cleanup: Lock files persist after process exit; cleaned up on next lock acquisition
risks.performance: File locking adds latency to add operations under high concurrency

acceptance_criteria_met: Two concurrent add() operations never produce todos with the same ID
After concurrent writes, all todo IDs in the file are unique
